text: By mid-afternoon, the heat rose in shimmering waves off the cracked clay.
'You will find only bones down there!'
the Hare called out mockingly from his shade.
'Why sweat like oxen when tomorrow the sky may weep rain on its own?'
But the animals did not pause.
In their silence lived the ancient truth: community is built not with advice from the shade, but with blistered hands in the sun.
